content:
**Beluga Whales** are creatures that appear in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update. 

Two Beluga Whales, Marty and Mary, were housed in the Aquarium of the Atlantic's Beluga Whale Exhibit. The bodies of the two whales remain in the drained exhibit.

Belugas, like whales and other sea mammals, enjoy living their lives in tanks. Scientists can tell how a Beluga is feeling based on the hormone content of their snot, and believe that one day they will be able to learn how to speak with them. [1] Whales cannot move their eyes and must turn their entire body to look around. [2]
